_comment: Expected outcomes live here, outside the reviewed fixture folders, so nothing the board reads gives the answer away. First decision = the ideal one; the others are defensible.

slugify.why: small, tested 1.0 package: exports, scoped name, documented Latin-only contract pinned by tests, MIT, CI

paykit.why: hardcoded live secret, double-charge on retry (no idempotency key), failure swallowed and reported as success

neuralguard.why: 99.9% / enterprise-ready claims backed by a Math.random() classifier, no tests, no evaluation
